data.name: Ashirah
data.gender_notes: Ashirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ashr', meaning ten. The name Ashirah signifies a joyful and content woman who is blessed with ten virtues. In Islamic history, Ashirah is also the name of a female companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) known for her generosity and hospitality. The name Ashirah carries the meaning “Happy, content, joyous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ashirah usually hope their child will grow to embody happy, content, joyous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ashirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Happy, content, joyous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashirah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: Ashirah holds an essential place in Islamic history as the name of a beloved companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). She is noted for her hospitality and generosity towards the Prophet, offering him and his companions a warm welcome and endless provisions during their travels. The name Ashirah continues to inspire cultural ideals of kindness, generosity, and genuine warmth extended towards guests and travelers.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, Ashirah's name is a reminder of the ten virtues or qualities a believer should cultivate in their character. These virtues include patience, humility, gratitude, forgiveness, perseverance, integrity, compassion, moderation, and generosity. Embracing these qualities not only strengthens one's connection with Allah but also fosters better relationships with family and community, ultimately leading to a more fulfilling and contented life.
